caption: The drawing features a large, rectangular wooden cabinet in the center, rendered in shades of brown. The cabinet has four doors, each door composed of recessed rectangular panels, with metal hinges and keyholes visible on both the upper and lower sets of doors. The cabinet is shown at an angle, with its left and front sides visible. Behind the cabinet is a partial depiction of a wall and a blue door, with parts of blue window or door frames and wainscoting on the wall also visible. The wall and trim are mostly off-white and blue. The floor trim at the bottom edge of the wall appears in a reddish-brown color. The background of the drawing is a plain, beige parchment or paper without other objects or detailing.
title: Shaker Dining Room Cupboard
